title: VendPoint Vend Pricing, Return-to-Machine and Vend Error Settings
content:
Billing settings of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program, by machine model.

- **Vend billing cycle**: how vends are billed. **Vend price basis**: price each vend is billed at.
- **Return to machine allowed**: whether unused items may be returned into the machine for credit. **Return window**: calendar days after the vend within which an unused item may be returned to the machine; 0 means not allowed. **Return credit basis**: price at which a returned item is credited.
- **Vend error reporting window**: hours after a failed vend within which it must be reported for credit. **Desk limit for vend error credits**: largest vend error credit, USD, the desk grants from the machine log without a technician check.

| | VendPoint Locker 12 | VendPoint Locker 24 | VendPoint Coil 40 | VendPoint Coil 60 | VendPoint Carousel 90 | VendPoint Smart Crib 300 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vend billing cycle | monthly | monthly | monthly | monthly | monthly | monthly |
| Vend price basis | contract price on the vend date | contract price on the vend date | contract price on the vend date | contract price on the vend date | contract price on the vend date | contract price on the vend date |
| Return to machine allowed | yes | yes | no | no | yes | yes |
| Return window, calendar days | 7 | 7 | 0 | 0 | 14 | 30 |
| Return credit basis | vend unit price | vend unit price | vend unit price | vend unit price | vend unit price | vend unit price |
| Vend error reporting window, hours | 24 | 24 | 48 | 48 | 48 | 72 |
| Desk limit for vend error credits, USD | 25.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 75.00 | 150.00 |

### Basis questions

**Which models take returns into the machine?** VendPoint Locker 12, Locker 24, Carousel 90 and Smart Crib 300. The two coil models show "no" and a return window of 0 days.

**What does "vend unit price" mean as a credit basis?** The unit price the original vend was billed at.

**Is the reporting window in calendar days?** No; it is stated in hours (24, 48 or 72 by model).
